nom: StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting ​Jawline & Neck Mask

segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s and 60s, including several going through menopause or weight loss, use the mask for sagging or crepiness around the jaw and neck; results range from a subtle, temporary firming to no noticeable change.
segments.sensitive: The reviewers who mention sensitive skin say the cooling hydrogel formula did not irritate them or cause breakouts.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report a temporary tightening or lifting effect right after removing the mask, often described as useful before an event, but a large share of the lower-starred reviews say they saw no visible difference at all, and several who did see something say it faded within hours and would likely need repeated use to last.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers describe the mask as strongly hydrating, leaving skin feeling plumped and moisturized even when they saw no firming effect.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports her chin broke out the day after use where the mask had touched it, while others, including one with sensitive skin, report no breakouts at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer describes stinging and burning during wear that left her face red for almost an hour afterward, which is not typical of most other reviews.

aspects.libelle: Sticky, fiddly to unfold and apply
Ear loops feel tight or uncomfortable
Only one single-use mask included per package
Comes with a bonus neck cream sample
High price for a single-use treatment

extraits.texte: Followed instructions to the letter including using strivectin neck tightening serum with the roller applicator. Absolutely zero difference before and after. No fewer lines, no tightening, no lifting. Waste of money.

extraits.texte: The StriVectin Jawline & Neck Mask is a lifting/firming treatment that takes 20 minutes After cleansing and moisturizing. Pros: It did seem to do something but it isn't very noticeable on 40s skin yet may be more effective for other skin Cons: After moisturizer so it is difficult to fit into a night regimen if you don't like the feeling of the product It hurt behind my ears, which the instructions say is an indicator of effectiveness however it was still loose on my actual jawline and neck despite the pain around my ears The texture of the product doesn't feel great on the skin it is almost slimy as well as cold. I would rather have a product that I can use prior to moisturizing so that I can wash afterwards and complete my regimen Perhaps it should come in different sizes because it didn't fit well on my smaller sized head Summary: it may be worth a try if you are looking for this type of product but it isn't a very pleasant treatment.

extraits.texte: I've lost 100 lbs without working out, and I'm going through menopause, which causes your skin to lose collagen and elastin, along with a loss of firmness and sagging around the neck and jawline. So, I was really excited to receive the TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask by StriVectin. After applying the form-fitting Jawline & Neck Mask with hydrogel, I instantly felt its tension and cooling effects, which gave me high hopes. After waiting 20 minutes, I removed the mask and felt that my jaw and neck were more firm, but unfortunately, that didn't last long. I believe that if I had more than one mask paired with their neck cream, I could see better results with continued use. So, it's hard to recommend without knowing if the jaw and neck mask would be effective if I had received more masks.

This really helped my neck before an event, however the next day the part of my chin where the mask was sitting broke out. I bought 3, so I'll have to experiment with putting it on where it only touches my neck, but I think having it slightly over thr chin is what makes it tight against the neck in order to be effective. :(

I was pleasantly surprised by the immediate tightening effect of this jawline mask. I loved that this was great even on my sensitive skin and did not break me out. It was comfortable to wear, did not cause any peeling, itching or redness. There was a lot of instant gratification which definitely makes the price point for this mask worth it. I also loved the bonus sample. I would definitely especially on my weight loss journey to keep my neck line and jaw tight.

I'm in my late 40's and am always looking for something to help my aging skin. This StriVectin TL Advanced Sculpting Neck & Jawline Mask is easy to use and actually stays in place once you hook it around your ears. It does feel a little odd, just because I'm used to face masks, rather than a mask for your chin and jawline. The gel is cooling and didn't notice any scent. The gel is very sticky! I enjoyed sitting and relaxing with this for around 20 minutes, it left my skin feeling a little tighter under the chin which is great as I'm starting to get a bit of a waddle under there! I think I'll purchase this again as I saw some good results and enjoyed taking some self care time to relax. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

I recently had the opportunity to try the Strivectin TL Advanced Sculpting Jawline & Neck Mask and I felt it made a notable difference in the appearance and texture of my face and neck. The mask was very easy to apply -- simply peel off the backing to the jawline part, stretch to fit across your jawline, press against jaw and chin, and loop the holes around your ears. Then peel the backing from the neck portion and also stretch so loops fit around your ears; press the neck part again the neck. The hydrogel formulation feels cooling and is fine for sensitive skin. The mask adheres with no slippage during the 20 minutes you leave it on. After 20 minutes, I removed the mask to reveal a lifted jawline and smoother, tighter neck. The slight crepiness I have when I move my neck was gone for the day! I definitely would recommend this product for delivering is promised results.
